newsitem.title: INDIA: Snag hits India Hindalco power plant.
newsitem.headline: Snag hits India Hindalco power plant.

text.p: Aluminium firm Hindalco Industries Ltd said it shut down a 75-Megawatt power unit on Wednesday due to a technical snag but production was unaffected.
The company expects to recommission the unit within four weeks, president A.K. Agarwala said in a statement. The firm has a total in-house generating capacity of 425 megawatts.
"This will not affect production," Agarwala said, adding the company was entitled to draw electricity from the government grid under a contract.

Consensus estimates of 18 brokerages and securities firms polled by Reuters showed Hindalco's net profits rising 23.4 percent to 2.5 billion rupees in the six months to September 30, 1997 from 2.0 billion in the year-ago period.
Sales are forecast to rise 36.5 percent to 7.0 billion rupees from 5.1 billion.
